lessons.title: Parentheticals often reveal the real connector
lessons.body: When one clue arrives with an extra nudge, it is often there to name the exact phrase logic hiding behind broader earlier clues.

lessons.title: Broad emotional themes are often traps
lessons.body: Words like start, positive, and alarm can invite big umbrella readings, but Pinpoint usually wants the tighter phrase answer.

lessons.title: A late clue can make earlier phrases feel obvious
